top_violation_types.title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985) (26 TAC §746.901(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Notarized affidavit was missing on file for one out of four staff files checked.

top_violation_types.title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The ground is splitting open and causing a tripping hazard at the entrance to the playground.       Photos taken

top_violation_types.title: Sign-in and Sign-out Tracking System (26 TAC §746.631(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Documentation showing children were signed into care was not available upon request.

top_violation_types.title: Location of Toilets (26 TAC §746.4409)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: During the investigation inspection it was found that the school age bathroom was not equipped with toilet paper and the caregiver did not have access to get any to replace it.

top_violation_types.title: Required Personnel Records - Photo Identification (26 TAC §746.901(9))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The driver's license copy on file for the center's driver was found to be expired at the time of  inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2912) (26 TAC §746.901(5))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Training hours for the caregivers were not available for review.

top_violation_types.title: Required Personnel Records (26 TAC §746.901)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One out of four employee records evaluated was unavailable for review.     One out of four employee records evaluated was incomplete.

top_violation_types.title: Pre-service Training for Caregivers of Children Under 24 Months (26 TAC §746.1305(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Infant room teacher was observed to not have pre-service training available  for review within caregiver record. The hire date was observed as 10/7/25.
